basic_info.description: Charming Inner Parkside tunnel-entry home with partial views from the top level! The upper floor features a spacious living room with a fireplace, a dining room, a kitchen, a full bath with a separate shower and tub, and two rear bedrooms side by side overlooking a large backyard with distant Pacific Ocean views. An additional 1/4 bath was added to one of the two bedrooms (unwarranted). Large deck off the two bedroom with direct access to the yard. The ground floor offers unwarranted two additional bedrooms, a wet bar, a full bath, and one-car parking with ample storage or potential for expansion. Recently updated with fresh interior and exterior paint, refinished hardwood floors, and new flooring. Conveniently located just 1.5 blocks from 19th Avenue, Noriega St, and Quintara St. public transportation, and Noriega Street cafes and shops. A classic gem in a prime location!
